title: Nutty Vietnamese Kippers Ca Kho To
description: A smoky, nutty Vietnamese stew featuring kippers simmered with caramel sauce, spices, and blanched greens, perfect for a date night.

ingredients.name: namul-blanch-seasoned spinach
ingredients.notes: blanched spinach seasoned with sesame oil, salt, and garlic

instructions: In a copper pot, combine the kippers, water, fish sauce, soy sauce, rice wine, and lemongrass, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the caramel sauce, brown sugar, and sliced ginger, stirring until the mixture is glossy and the sugar dissolves.
Sprinkle the kaffir lime leaves and minced garlic into the pot, then cover and let the stew gently bubble for 10 minutes to infuse the aromatics.
Remove the lid, reduce the heat to low, and simmer uncovered for an additional 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and the kippers are tender.
Stir in the namul-blanch-seasoned spinach, toasted cashews, and chopped cilantro, cooking for 2 minutes just until the greens warm.
Transfer the stew to a serving dish, garnish with sliced scallions and a pinch of chili flakes, and serve hot straight from the copper pot.
